records.name: Angular UMenu
records.purpose: Flat navigation or command list, inline or imperatively opened as a popup anchored to a triggering element.
records.surface: Selector u-menu. Inputs model: UMenuItem[] = [], popup=false (booleanAttribute), appendTo?: HTMLElement | (() => HTMLElement), baseZIndex=0 (numberAttribute), closeOnEscape=true (booleanAttribute). Outputs onShow/onHide: void. Public toggle(event), show(event), hide(event?) manage popup visibility; show is a no-op in inline mode. Enabled item activation calls command with the raw MouseEvent and closes a popup. ArrowDown/ArrowUp move native focus among anchors, skipping disabled anchors. Provides ComponentIdGenerator for composed UTooltip; composes URipple, RouterModule and UOverlay. Resolves appendTo per open; positions below target in a microtask, sets ZIndex, and registers outside-click/resize and display-order Escape resources released on hide/destroy. MenuClassesParams (popup/focused/disabled) and menuStyleModule are source-only style exports, not barrel API. menuStyleModule wraps @ultimate/uix-styles/menu CSS with local class resolvers. Extends UBaseComponent, which owns shared component lifecycle/style handling. Consumer availability: @ultimate/ng#UMenu via selected root/family barrels and manifest entries; source-only exports mentioned above are not package barrel API. All remaining class state, event/DOM handlers and local css/classes constants in the listed files are implementation parts owned by this record, not independent products. Aura preset registers the menu component token family; this is source configuration, not rendered-theme verification. MENU_METADATA in component-metadata records links to the Angular implementation; generated menu.api.mdx is supporting documentation. Inherited inputs dt?: Record<string,unknown> and unstyled?: boolean come from UBaseComponent; its ngOnInit registers theme variables and component CSS through the per-document stylesheet. Shared UMenuItem supports optional label/icon/url/routerLink/command/items/separator/disabled/visible/target/tooltip; each component consumes only the fields described above, not automatically every field in the shared type.
